name: approved_idsd_package_creates_plan_tracker_and_handoff
input: The IDSD package is approved. Write a multi-phase plan, create a tracker, and prepare Codex CLI native execution.

expected.planDraftingPolicy: draft full detailed plan before splitting
expected.splitPolicy: no line cap on project plans; split by phase boundary so each phase stays independently executable; root plan stays an index
expected.qualityGateInputs: solution_challenger, system_designer, and senior_qa evidence considered when selected
expected.trackerHandoff: completed phase summary, intent alignment, remaining gaps, and next phase dependencies recorded

name: stale_runtime_state_blocks_advance
input: The tracker exists, but current-work.json still points at an older plan. Do not continue blindly.

expected.blockers: refresh runtime state before the next phase

name: phase_done_without_qa_verdict_blocks_advance
input: Phase 1 execution finished and all tests are green, but the tracker has no post-execution QA verdict. Tick the phase done.

expected.blockers: record post-execution QA verdict (ticket AC vs PR diff) before ticking done

name: qa_fail_verdict_blocks_advance
input: The post-execution QA verdict is FAIL with uncovered AC items, but the happy path is green. Advance to Phase 2.

expected.nextAction: fix uncovered AC items and re-verify; do not advance on happy-path green alone
